description.zh: 指定用户在下次登录时是否必须绑定多因素认证器。默认为`false`。
description.en: Specifies whether the RAM user must bind a multi-factor authentication (MFA) device upon the next logon. Default value: `false`.

description.zh: 指定密码，密码必须符合密码强度要求。关于密码强度设置要求，请参见[GetPasswordPolicy](~~2337691~~)。
description.en: The logon password of the RAM user. The password must meet the password strength requirements. For more information, see [GetPasswordPolicy](~~2337691~~).

description.zh: 指定用户在登录时是否需要修改密码。默认为`false`。
description.en: Specifies whether the RAM user has to change the password upon logon. Default value: `false`.
The name of the RAM user.

title.zh: 为一个RAM用户启用Web控制台登录

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ram create-login-profile --user-name zhangq0000 --password mypassword --password-reset-required false --mfa-bind-required false --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ram CreateLoginProfile --region cn-hangzhou --PasswordResetRequired false --UserName zhangq0000 --MFABindRequired false --Password mypassword
